tool.name: GninaRun

param.name: input_ligand_path
param.label: input SDF,MOL2,PDB,PDBQT file
param.help: Path to the input ligand. It may hold several ligands and it must hold genuine 3D coordinates, as gnina samples torsions but never bond lengths, bond angles or ring conformations. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_receptor_path
param.label: input PDB,PDBQT file
param.help: Path to the input receptor. Every atom of this file is treated as rigid receptor, so any crystal ligand must be removed beforehand. Provide a PDBQT file for full control over protonation, as PDBQT input is passed to gnina unmodified. Charges are not taken into account, just hydrogen donor/acceptor character which depends on the protonation state. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_box_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to the PDB file with the box center and size annotated as a REMARK, as written by the box and box_residues building blocks. Mutually exclusive with input_autobox_path. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: input_autobox_path
param.label: input SDF,MOL2,PDB,PDBQT,PQR file
param.help: Path to a reference structure whose bounding coordinates define the docking box, for example a crystal ligand, an fpocket pocket or the whole receptor. It only needs atoms with Cartesian coordinates, it does not need to be a real molecule. Mutually exclusive with input_box_path. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_sdf_path
param.label: output SDF,GZ name
param.help: Path to the output file with the docked poses and their scores as SD data fields. Use a .sdf.gz extension to obtain gzip compressed output Format: [output].[format]

param.name: outname_output_summary_path
param.label: output JSON name
param.help: Path to the JSON summary file, holding one entry per output pose with the ligand it belongs to and every score gnina assigned to it Format: [output].json

param.name: outname_output_log_path
param.label: output LOG name
param.help: Path to the log file written by gnina Format: [output].log

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: cpu
param.label: cpu
param.help: Number of CPU cores to use. Keep it lower than or equal to exhaustiveness, and always set it explicitly on a shared machine.

param.name: exhaustiveness
param.label: exhaustiveness
param.help: Number of independent Monte Carlo search chains. This is the main sampling knob, but it gives diminishing returns past the default for a targeted pocket.

param.name: num_modes
param.label: num_modes
param.help: Maximum number of binding modes written out.

param.name: min_rmsd_filter
param.label: min_rmsd_filter
param.help: RMSD in Angstroms below which a pose is dropped as redundant with a better ranked one.

param.name: num_mc_saved
param.label: num_mc_saved
param.help: Number of top poses retained in each Monte Carlo chain, gnina defaults to 50 when unset.

param.name: seed
param.label: seed
param.help: Explicit random seed. Docking is stochastic, so set it for reproducible runs.

param.name: scoring
param.label: scoring
param.help: Built-in empirical scoring function, gnina uses its own default when unset.
param.option: default - the gnina default empirical scoring function
vina - the AutoDock Vina scoring function
vinardo - a reparameterization of the Vina terms that often does better for virtual screening
dkoes_fast - a fast variant of the dkoes scoring function
dkoes_scoring_old - the legacy dkoes scoring function

param.name: cnn_scoring
param.label: cnn_scoring
param.help: Where the convolutional neural network is used in the pipeline, gnina defaults to rescore when unset.
param.option: rescore - the network only re-ranks the final pool of poses
metrorescore - network rescoring combined with Metropolis sampling
metrorefine - network refinement combined with Metropolis sampling

param.name: cnn
param.label: cnn
param.help: Name of a built-in convolutional neural network model, or a name ending in _ensemble to evaluate every built-in model sharing that prefix. gnina defaults to an ensemble of three models when unset.

param.name: pose_sort_order
param.label: pose_sort_order
param.help: How the internal pose pool is sorted before the redundancy filter and the num_modes cutoff are applied, so it can surface a different set of poses and not merely reorder them. gnina defaults to CNNscore when unset.

option.value: which answers whether a pose is right

param.option: which answers whether a pose is right

option.value: which is what ranks compounds in a screen

param.option: which is what ranks compounds in a screen

param.name: autobox_add
param.label: autobox_add
param.help: Buffer in Angstroms added on every side of the box derived from input_autobox_path, gnina defaults to 4 when unset. A larger box does not slow gnina down, but it does loosen the constraint on sampling.

param.name: autobox_extend
param.label: autobox_extend
param.help: Enlarge the box derived from input_autobox_path when needed so the input ligand can rotate freely inside it, gnina enables this when unset.

param.name: minimize
param.label: minimize
param.help: Energy minimize the poses given in input_ligand_path instead of searching for new ones.

param.name: score_only
param.label: score_only
param.help: Score the poses given in input_ligand_path without searching or minimizing.

param.name: local_only
param.label: local_only
param.help: Restrict the search to a local one inside the box.

param.name: no_gpu
param.label: no_gpu
param.help: Disable GPU acceleration even when a GPU is available.

param.name: device
param.label: device
param.help: Index of the GPU device to use.

param.name: quiet
param.label: quiet
param.help: Suppress the gnina output messages.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the gnina executable in your local computer. gnina is not distributed with this package, install it from its binary release or run it through a container.

param.name: output_format
param.label: output_format
param.help: Format of the output file
